name: saysmy
description: See what your AI says about you. Make a few questions, send them to friends, and let everyone’s AI answer about them.

interface.shortDescription: What your AI says about you
interface.longDescription:
See what your AI says about you.

Make a few questions, send them to friends, and let everyone’s AI answer about them.

Make a survey by talking: settle on a title and a few questions, and you get a short link to send to friends. When someone shares a saysmy.ai link with you, ChatGPT can read the questions behind it. When you have answers you are happy with, ChatGPT can turn them into an answers link to share, and you can leave any answer out.

There are no accounts and nothing to sign in to. saysmy.ai saves the questions and approved answers you put in a link. A link cannot be edited: a change makes a new link. Anyone who has a link can read it. Shared answers are automatically deleted after 3 days; reads do not extend that deadline. Question links expire after 90 days without a read. Expired links show a 404 page. Links can also be removed early on request.

Limits: up to 20 questions per survey. Answers are short text, and at least one has to be shared. Answers are an AI's guesses about a person, meant as a party game, not as facts or advice.
defaultPrompt: Make a saysmy.ai survey about what I'm like when I'm stressed.
Read this saysmy.ai link and show me its questions.
Turn my answers into a saysmy.ai link I can share.

positive.description: Create a survey link from a title and two questions.
positive.prompt: Make a saysmy.ai survey titled "What am I like when I'm stressed?" with these two questions: "What do I do first when a deadline gets close?" and "What do I keep promising to start?"
positive.expected_behavior: Returns one short link that starts with https://saysmy.ai/ask/. Opening it shows the title and both questions with an "Ask your AI" button. Explains the 90-day idle expiry.

positive.description: Read a survey link and list what is behind it.
positive.prompt: What questions are in this link? https://saysmy.ai/ask/nL8qV6NAeN
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the title "What am I like when I'm stressed?" and its two questions, in order.

positive.description: Create an answers link from answers the user supplied and approved.
positive.prompt: For this survey https://saysmy.ai/ask/nL8qV6NAeN my answers are: 1) I reorganize my to-do list instead of doing anything on it. 2) A workout plan. I have planned four. Make me a share link under the name Jules.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns one short link that starts with https://saysmy.ai/answers/. Opening it shows the name Jules, "asked their ChatGPT", and both answers under their questions. Before sharing, explains that anyone with the link can read it and that it expires after 3 days. The tool returns the exact expiry, and the page shows it; reads do not extend it.

positive.description: Leave one answer out of the share link.
positive.prompt: For this survey https://saysmy.ai/ask/nL8qV6NAeN share only my first answer, "I reorganize my to-do list instead of doing anything on it.", and leave the second one out. Use the name Jules.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a short https://saysmy.ai/answers/ link. On the page the first question shows the answer and the second question shows a blank dashed line with no answer. This is a new URL with a fixed 3-day deadline.

positive.description: Handle a link that has nothing behind it.
positive.expected_behavior: The tool reports that the link may be expired, removed or mistyped and asks for a fresh link. No questions are invented. Opening an unavailable survey returns HTTP 404, says "This survey is no longer available", and offers "Make a survey". An unavailable answers link instead says "This survey result is no longer available" and asks the owner to publish a new one, with the same button.

negative.description: The plugin has no tool that deletes a link. The reply should say it cannot delete the link itself and point to saysmy.ai/support, where a link can be removed on request. No tool is called.
negative.prompt: Delete the saysmy.ai survey link you made for me earlier.

negative.description: The plugin cannot list responses. The reply should explain that saysmy.ai keeps no list of who opened or answered a survey, and that answers arrive only as links people choose to send. No tool is called.
negative.prompt: Show me everyone who has answered my saysmy.ai survey so far.

negative.description: The plugin cannot send messages. The reply should say it can only make the link, and that the user sends it themselves. It may still offer to create the survey link.
negative.prompt: Using only the saysmy.ai plugin, email my saysmy.ai survey to all my contacts.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell anything or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Create surveys and share answers you approve. Shared answers are text and expire after 3 days; reads do not extend the deadline. Surveys expire after 90 days without a read. Unavailable results ask the owner to publish a new one. Unavailable surveys show their own message. Both offer Make a survey.
